hooks.description: Display a macOS system notification when Claude Code requires user attention or input
hooks.command: osascript -e 'display notification "Claude Code needs your attention" with title "Claude Code"'

hooks.description: Extract the modified file path from the hook payload and automatically format the file with Prettier
If the modified file is a Markdown document inside /docs/, run markdown linting and fail the workflow on lint errors
hooks.command:
python3 -c "
import json, sys
d = json.load(sys.stdin)
path = d.get('tool_input', {}).get('file_path', '')
if '/docs/' in path and path.endswith('.md'):
    import subprocess, sys
    result = subprocess.run(['npm', 'run', 'lint:md'], capture_output=True, text=True)
    if result.returncode != 0:
        print(result.stdout)
        print('LINT FAILED — fix errors above before proceeding')
        sys.exit(1)
"
